# Divegrass Before Christmas 7

A player's rating is his best of: dribbling, goalkeeping, finishing, low pass, lofted pass, heading, swerve, catching, clearing, reflexes, coverage, body control, physical contact, kicking power, explosive power, ball control, ball winning, jump, place kicking, stamina, speed, aggression.
May sit below their target: attacking prowess, ball control, dribbling, low pass, lofted pass, finishing, place kicking, swerve, heading, defensive prowess, ball winning, kicking power, speed, explosive power, body control, physical contact, jump, goalkeeping, catching, clearing, reflexes, coverage, stamina, tight possession, aggression, form, injury resistance, weak foot usage, weak foot accuracy.

## Tiers
- **Gold**: by medal system; every stat 99; form 8, injury resistance 3, weak foot 4/4; 48 paid cards; 13 A positions.
- **Silver**: by medal system; every stat 88; an ability stat that may sit below its target warns up to 5 over it, past that it is not allowed; those stats added up may not exceed their targets' sum; form 8, injury resistance 3, weak foot 4/4; 48 paid cards; 13 A positions.
- **Regular**: the rest of the squad; every stat 77; an ability stat that may sit below its target warns up to 7 over it, past that it is not allowed; those stats added up may not exceed their targets' sum; form 8, injury resistance 3, weak foot 4/4; 48 paid cards; 13 A positions.
Medal systems: GGG (3 Gold, 0 Silver), GGSS (2 Gold, 2 Silver), GSSSS (1 Gold, 4 Silver) or SSSSSS (0 Gold, 6 Silver).

## Heights
Brackets: Manlet 175, Mid 180, Tall 185, Giant 195 cm.
- **Height** (when the team meets its quotas): 6 manlet, 5 mid, 6 tall, 6 giant.
- **Manlet** (when the team meets its quotas): 6 manlet, 7 mid, 10 tall, 0 giant.
- **Universal** (when the team meets its quotas): 0 manlet, 0 mid, 23 tall, 0 giant.
- **GigaHeight** (otherwise): 6 manlet, 10 mid, 7 tall, 0 giant; 50 cm to share, no player above 210.

## Every team
At most 41 skill cards.

## Special rules
- **Goalkeepers at 189 count as 185**: Registered GK, 189 cm: count 4 cm shorter.
- **Manlet bonus**: Under Manlet, 175 cm or less: may get +5 for Silver, +5 for Regular to every stat.
- **Manlet regulars: warning band 5**: Under Manlet, 175 cm or less: warning band 5 for Regular.
- **Goalkeepers at 189 have no second A position**: Registered GK, 189 cm: at most 1 A position.
- **The registered position must be rated A** (warning): Any of (registered GK, except rated A at GK; registered CB, except rated A at CB; registered LB, except rated A at LB; registered RB, except rated A at RB; registered DMF, except rated A at DMF; registered CMF, except rated A at CMF; registered LMF, except rated A at LMF; registered RMF, except rated A at RMF; registered AMF, except rated A at AMF; registered LWF, except rated A at LWF; registered RWF, except rated A at RWF; registered SS, except rated A at SS; registered CF, except rated A at CF): not allowed ("The registered position is not rated A").
